mapper.select: select l.id as laorenId, l.laoren_bianhao as laorenBianhao, l.xingming as laorenXingming, l.laoren_leixing as laorenLeixing, l.ruzhu_zhuangtai as ruzhuZhuangtai, hj.id as jibieId, hj.jibie_mingcheng as jibieMingcheng, lh.shezhi_riqi as shezhiRiqi, lh.daoqi_riqi as daoqiRiqi, lh.zhuangtai as huliZhuangtai from laoren_xinxi l left join laoren_huli lh on l.id = lh.laoren_id and lh.zhuangtai = '生效' left join huli_jibie hj on lh.jibie_id = hj.id where l.ruzhu_zhuangtai != '已删除' order by l.id desc

select lh.id, lh.laoren_id as laorenId, lh.jibie_id as jibieId, hj.jibie_mingcheng as jibieMingcheng, lh.shezhi_riqi as shezhiRiqi, lh.daoqi_riqi as daoqiRiqi, lh.zhuangtai, lh.beizhu from laoren_huli lh join huli_jibie hj on lh.jibie_id = hj.id where lh.laoren_id = #{laorenId} and lh.zhuangtai = '生效' limit 1
mapper.update: update laoren_huli set zhuangtai = '已结束' where laoren_id = #{laorenId} and zhuangtai = '生效'
update laoren_xinxi set laoren_leixing = #{laorenLeixing} where id = #{laorenId}
